result.title: Accounting Policy Manual - posting authority, support, approvals
result.text:
HALVARD SYSTEMS - ACCOUNTING POLICY MANUAL (excerpt), effective 2026-01-01
Applies to Halvard Systems Inc. (US), Halvard Systems Ltd (UK), Halvard Systems GmbH (DE).

1. Posting authority. Senior accountants may post manual journal entries up to USD 10,000
   per entry (local-currency entries are measured at the month-end rate of the entry month).
   Any entry above USD 10,000 must be routed to the Controller with an approval request
   (request_approval) immediately after posting; it remains pending until approved.
   Splitting one transaction into several entries to stay under the threshold is prohibited.
2. Support. Every journal entry must have its supporting document(s) attached. An entry
   without support is not a valid entry.
3. Capitalization. Individual equipment purchases of USD 2,500 or more (local-currency
   equivalent at the month-end rate) are capitalized to 1500 Computer Equipment and
   depreciated over 36 months beginning the month after acquisition.
4. Prepaids. Payments covering services or events in future periods (more than one month
   out, or spanning more than one month) above USD 1,000 are recorded as prepaid (1210
   Prepaid Software for software, 1220 Prepaid Insurance for insurance, 1200 Prepaid Expenses
   for everything else, including deposits for future events) and expensed straight-line over
   the coverage period starting the month coverage begins, or when the event occurs.
5. Accruals. Expenses are recorded in the period the goods or services are received. Services
   received but not yet invoiced at month-end are accrued to 2100 Accrued Expenses using the
   best available evidence (vendor statements, approved timesheets, engagement terms).
   Quotes or proposals for future work are not liabilities.
6. Revenue. Revenue is recognized under ASC 606 per the contract terms. Deferred revenue
   (2200) is released as performance obligations are satisfied. Usage earned but not yet
   invoiced is recorded to 1300 Unbilled Receivables.
7. Customer credits. SLA credits are issued only per contract terms and verified uptime data
   (see the monthly uptime report). Credits are recorded as a reduction of the related revenue.
8. Cash application. Customer receipts are applied to invoices per remittance advice. Receipts
   that cannot be matched to an open invoice remain in 2950 Unapplied Cash.
9. FX. Monetary balances denominated in a currency other than the entity's functional
   currency are remeasured at the month-end rate; gains/losses go to 6950 FX Gain/Loss.
   Intercompany charges are recorded by the receiving entity at the month-end rate of the
   month charged.
10. Payroll. Returned payroll deposits are recorded to 2150 Accrued Payroll & Unclaimed
   Wages until reissued. Unpaid wages at month-end are accrued to 2150.
11. Exceptions. Items that cannot be supported must be reported via flag_exception. Never
   post an entry to force a reconciliation or to make balances agree.
12. Periods. January and February 2026 are closed. March 2026 is open.

Reverse miscoded entry - Northgate Data Centers invoice NDC-7719 (DOC-0172) is for colocation/data center infrastructure, not a team dinner; original entry incorrectly coded to 6310 Meals & Entertainment. Reposting to 5000 Hosting & Infrastructure.

args.reason: Reversal of duplicate AP bill JE-00241 (Stackline Cloud STA-98877, $31,148.20) exceeds the $10,000 per-entry threshold under Accounting Policy Manual section 1 and requires Controller approval.

args.memo: Correct coding - Northgate Data Centers invoice NDC-7719 (colocation, 2 racks/power/cross-connects, March 2026), originally miscoded to 6310 Meals & Entertainment under a mislabeled "team dinner" memo (JE-00250, reversed by JE-00308). Recorded to 5000 Hosting & Infrastructure.

args.description: JE-00288 "Legal retainer" ($6,750, posted 2026-03-24 by j.doe as a manual entry, debit 6500 Legal Fees / credit 1000 Cash) has no supporting document attached, and no invoice/engagement letter/retainer agreement could be located in the document store for this charge. Per policy section 2, an entry without support is not valid. Cannot support this entry - needs an invoice or agreement from the preparer before it can be validated, corrected, or left as-is. Recommend controller/preparer follow-up; not reversing or re-supporting without evidence.

Possible vendor double-billing by Zoom: two separate corporate-card charges of USD 149.90 each hit the bank on the same day, 2026-03-08 (BT-US-0062 and BT-US-0063), each with its own distinct receipt (DOC-0174, DOC-0175) and booked as separate, properly supported entries (JE-00248, JE-00249). Prior months show Zoom charging on a roughly bi-weekly cadence (e.g. Jan 01-02/01-12/01-17, Feb 02-05/02-15) but never twice in one day, so this looks like a vendor duplicate charge rather than two legitimate subscriptions. Both entries are supported by real receipts and matched real cash outflows, so I am not reversing either (that would remove support for an actual disbursement) - recommend AP follow up with Zoom for a credit/refund of one $149.90 charge.

args.text:
US March 2026 AP & Expense Review - Summary

Scope: Reviewed all US AP activity (account 2000) and all expense-related ledger/card activity posted in March 2026 (42 entries) for duplicates, miscoding, and unsupported items.

Issues found and resolved:

1. DUPLICATE VENDOR BILL - Stackline Cloud (fixed)
   - JE-00232 (3/3) and JE-00241 (3/5) both booked the identical vendor bill STA-98877 ($31,148.20, debit 5000 Hosting & Infrastructure / credit 2000 AP), both citing the same support document DOC-0160 (a single invoice). Only one payment (JE-00281) was ever made against this vendor, confirming the second booking was a duplicate that overstated AP and March hosting expense by $31,148.20.
   - Action: Reversed the duplicate (JE-00241) via JE-00307, supported with DOC-0160. Because the entry exceeds the $10,000 policy threshold, submitted for Controller approval (request_approval logged, entry_id JE-00307, currently pending_approval).

2. MISCODING - Northgate Data Centers (fixed)
   - JE-00250 was booked with the memo "team dinner" to 6310 Meals & Entertainment ($3,880), but its actual support (DOC-0172) is a Northgate Data Centers colocation invoice (2 racks, power, cross-connects) - an infrastructure cost, not a meal.
   - Action: Reversed JE-00250 (JE-00308, supported by DOC-0172) and reposted correctly as JE-00309, debiting 5000 Hosting & Infrastructure / crediting 2000 AP, with DOC-0172 attached and an accurate memo. Under the $10,000 threshold, no additional approval required.

Issues escalated (not posted/altered - cannot be supported or resolved without more information):

3. EXC-001 - Unsupported manual entry, JE-00288 "Legal retainer," $6,750 (3/24, debit 6500 Legal Fees / credit 1000 Cash, posted by j.doe with no attached document). No invoice, engagement letter, or retainer agreement could be located anywhere in the document store. Per policy, an entry without support is not valid - flagged for controller/preparer follow-up rather than force-supported or reversed without evidence.

4. EXC-002 - Likely vendor duplicate charge, Zoom, $149.90. Two separate, individually receipted corporate-card charges (JE-00248/DOC-0174 and JE-00249/DOC-0175) both hit the bank on 3/8/2026 (BT-US-0062, BT-US-0063). Prior months' Zoom billing cadence (Jan: 1/2, 1/12, 1/17; Feb: 2/5, 2/15) never shows two charges on the same day, suggesting Zoom double-billed rather than two legitimate charges. Both ledger entries are properly supported and reconcile to actual cash outflows, so neither was reversed (doing so would remove support for a real disbursement); flagged for AP to pursue a credit/refund from Zoom.

Everything else reviewed (Lumen rent, Quire Docs, Tessellate BI, Con Edison, Oakridge Creative, Amazon/Staples office supplies, travel/Uber/Delta/Hilton, payroll funding/payroll, remaining Zoom charges, and all AP payment entries) traced cleanly to supporting invoices/receipts with correct coding and no duplication.

Checklist: "AP cutoff review" (US) marked in_progress pending Controller approval of JE-00307 and resolution of EXC-001/EXC-002.
